facts.title: terrae - Composable map components for React
facts.description: A collection of beautifully designed, animated, accessible, and customizable map components. Built on Mapbox GL and MapLibre GL. Styled with Tailwind CSS. Works with shadcn/ui.
facts.keywords: react map,next.js map,mapbox,mapbox gl,map components,shadcn map,tailwind map,react map library,typescript map,interactive maps,map markers,map controls

research.name: terrae
research.note: Composable React map components on Mapbox and MapLibre, with animated weather and disaster overlays such as cyclones.
unverified: The components' source is public in the GitHub repository alamenai/terrae, linked from the site; that repository has not yet been researched in place of this site.
Only the cyclone overlay was seen on screen; the other effects are described in the changelog.
